The '''''Golden Jewel''''' was the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] assigned to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talnar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Talnar was shot down in the ''Golden Jewel'' by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Guardian-class light cruiser]] and forced to crash-land on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]].<ref name="Talnar's Rescue" />
